## Summary

Describe what changed.

## Outcome

Describe what changes as a result, including before/after behavior when useful.

## Validation

### Pre-merge acceptance

Describe applicable checks and their results, including any missing mandatory acceptance.

### Required post-merge verification

List only required checks that need to follow merge, how to perform them and their status, or state that none are required. Report unperformed or environment-blocked checks honestly as pending. Record subsequent evidence and defect follow-up using the [development flow](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#6-perform-required-post-merge-verification).

## Related issues

Use `Closes #N` for an Issue fully implemented with mandatory pre-merge acceptance satisfied, even if post-merge-only verification is pending. For intentional partial work, use a non-closing link and state the remaining scope. See the [review guidance](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/docs/review-guidelines.md#check-acceptance-and-verification).
